notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jadzi by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
Resolve all Jadzi abilities, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

uses.name: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle
